name: macbook
description: Measure this Mac and authorize one-time native Mac login password fills without exposing the secret.

interface.shortDescription: Measure this Mac and approve native credential fills
interface.longDescription: Live measurements for the Mac this agent runs on plus one-time, human-approved Mac login password fills into signed native secure dialogs. The credential broker never returns secret content, rejects web fields, and never submits the surrounding action.
